name: tokens
title: Tokens da e-Auditoria
description: Cor, tipografia, espaçamento, raio e sombra da marca, como variáveis CSS. É a fonte da verdade — não copie hexadecimal.

files.content:
{
  "cor": {
    "--ea-navy": "#050634",
    "--ea-blue": "#2488ff",
    "--ea-iris": "#2f24ff",
    "--ea-violet": "#4f45f5",
    "--ea-purple": "#8439e6",
    "--ea-cyan": "#00ffea",
    "--ea-yellow": "#fec008",
    "--ea-orange": "#fb5507",
    "--ea-pink": "#ff0071",
    "--ea-red": "#ff2f34",
    "--ea-white": "#ffffff",
    "--ea-ice": "#f5f9fc",
    "--ea-gray-200": "#a2b9da",
    "--ea-gray-500": "#576b86",
    "--ea-graphite": "#1e2126",
    "--ea-black": "#000000",
    "--ea-color-primary-hover": "#241bcf",
    "--ea-text-on-dark": "#e9ecfb",
    "--ea-text-muted-on-dark": "#9aa3d6",
    "--ea-border": "#e4e9f5",
    "--ea-success": "#10b981",
    "--ea-glass-light": "rgba(255,255,255,.70)",
    "--ea-glass-dark": "rgba(255,255,255,.06)",
    "--ea-glass-border": "rgba(255,255,255,.14)",
    "--ea-pastel-lilas": "#e7e2ff",
    "--ea-pastel-peri": "#dfe2ff",
    "--ea-pastel-azul": "#dbe7ff",
    "--ea-pastel-lav": "#efe6ff",
    "--ea-pastel-baun": "#fff0c4",
    "--ea-pastel-ciano": "#d9f5f0",
    "--ea-pastel-uva": "#f0e3ff",
    "--ea-pastel-rosa": "#ffe1f0"
  },
  "gradiente": {
    "--ea-grad-text": "linear-gradient(135deg, #4f45f5, #8439e6)",
    "--ea-grad-text-tri": "linear-gradient(125deg, #2f24ff 0%, #8439e6 55%, #ff0071 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-data": "linear-gradient(90deg, #00ffea, #4f45f5, #8439e6)",
    "--ea-grad-dark": "linear-gradient(140deg, #06063a 0%, #0d0540 50%, #1c0860 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-dark-soft": "linear-gradient(180deg, #050634 0%, #0a0c44 50%, #050634 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-light": "linear-gradient(220deg, #ddd6fe 0%, #c7dbff 48%, #e5daff 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-aurora": "linear-gradient(135deg, #d8e8ff 0%, #eeeaff 40%, #f8e8ff 70%, #fff8ee 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-masthead": "linear-gradient(122deg, #8439e6 0%, #5b4bf2 46%, #2488ff 100%)",
    "--ea-grad-live": "linear-gradient(135deg, #fb5507, #ff2f34)"
  },
  "tipografia": {
    "--ea-font-display": "'Familjen Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif",
    "--ea-font-body": "'Manrope', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif",
    "--ea-fs-display": "clamp(2.5rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5.25rem)",
    "--ea-fs-h1": "clamp(2.25rem, 4vw + 0.5rem, 4rem)",
    "--ea-fs-h2": "clamp(1.75rem, 3vw + 0.5rem, 3.625rem)",
    "--ea-fs-h3": "clamp(1.375rem, 1.5vw + 0.5rem, 2rem)",
    "--ea-fs-stat": "clamp(2.5rem, 4vw + 0.5rem, 4rem)",
    "--ea-fs-lead": "clamp(1.0625rem, 0.6vw + 0.9rem, 1.1875rem)",
    "--ea-fs-body": "1rem",
    "--ea-fs-sm": "0.875rem",
    "--ea-fs-xs": "0.75rem",
    "--ea-lh-tight": "1.05",
    "--ea-lh-snug": "1.3",
    "--ea-lh-body": "1.6",
    "--ea-tracking-tight": "-0.02em",
    "--ea-tracking-wide": "0.12em"
  },
  "espaco": {
    "--ea-space-1": "0.25rem",
    "--ea-space-2": "0.5rem",
    "--ea-space-3": "0.75rem",
    "--ea-space-4": "1rem",
    "--ea-space-5": "1.5rem",
    "--ea-space-6": "2rem",
    "--ea-space-7": "3rem",
    "--ea-space-8": "4rem",
    "--ea-space-9": "6rem",
    "--ea-section-y": "clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7.5rem)"
  },
  "raio": {
    "--ea-radius-sm": "12px",
    "--ea-radius-md": "20px",
    "--ea-radius-lg": "28px",
    "--ea-radius-xl": "40px",
    "--ea-radius-pill": "999px"
  },
  "sombra": {
    "--ea-shadow-sm": "0 4px 24px rgba(5,6,52,.08)",
    "--ea-shadow-md": "0 12px 40px rgba(60,40,140,.14)",
    "--ea-shadow-lg": "0 32px 80px rgba(47,36,255,.22)",
    "--ea-glow-cta": "0 0 44px rgba(254,192,8,.36)",
    "--ea-blur-glass": "blur(16px)"
  },
  "outro": {
    "--ea-ease": "cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)",
    "--ea-dur-fast": "0.2s",
    "--ea-dur": "0.4s",
    "--ea-dur-slow": "0.8s",
    "--ea-container": "1180px",
    "--ea-z-header": "1000",
    "--ea-z-overlay": "2000"
  }
}
